I implemented all six functions in `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and `tests/test_expr_eval.py` now passes (25 tests). I didn't change the test file or run the rest of the suite.

The logic follows the module docstring and the assignment: NULL comparisons give NULL, mixed SQL types raise `TypeMismatchError`, and NOT/AND/OR use three-valued logic. `where_matches` returns True only when the result is exactly True.

Two small additions go beyond the spec. `compare` raises `TypeMismatchError` for an unknown operator. `evaluate` does the same for an unrecognised expression node. I also added a private helper, `_check_bool`, which the logical functions and `where_matches` share.
